Plants absorb **carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$)** from the air to carry out photosynthesis. 

Using energy from sunlight, plants combine carbon dioxide and water to produce glucose (sugar) for energy, releasing **oxygen ($\text{O}_2$)** back into the air as a byproduct:

$$6\text{CO}_2 + 6\text{H}_2\text{O} + \text{light energy} \rightarrow \text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_6 + 6\text{O}_2$$
